headline: Your deck rebuilds itself around what you missed.
rebuild_note: Mass versus weight was the tricky one, so it now has a worked example card.

retired.text: What is the unit of force?
retired.why: Right every time, so it's taking a break

reworded.old: What happens to an object when the forces on it are balanced?
reworded.new: If the forces on an object are balanced, what is the resultant force?

added.text: An astronaut has a mass of 60 kg on Earth. What is their mass on the Moon?

caption:
Got 7 out of 10? Your deck should care about the 3. 🎯

After a session, adaptive mode rebuilds the deck around what you keep missing: cards you nail every time take a break, confusing ones get reworded, and new cards show up for the exact idea that tripped you up.

Works for quizzes too, and Autopilot schedules what's due around how you did.
